explain.title: What is Enable Banking?
explain.body: Enable Banking is a free, PSD2-regulated aggregator that lets Picsou talk to European banks on your behalf. It's audited and free for personal use.
explain.psd2Body: PSD2 is the EU regulation that lets licensed aggregators read your bank account with your consent. Your credentials never leave your bank.
explain.prodWarningBody: In your Enable Banking dashboard, make sure to choose "Production" when creating the application — the SANDBOX only gives you access to fake test banks, not your real ones.
explain.psd2ScopeNote: Enable Banking only syncs current accounts (PSD2 limitation). For PEA, life insurance, savings accounts, etc.: use the dedicated integrations (Trade Republic, Boursobank, Finary) or add them manually.
explain.magicLinkHint: Enter your email on the sign-in page. Enable Banking creates your account on first sign-in and sends you a one-time sign-in link.

creds.title: Paste your Application ID
creds.body: Copy the Application ID of the application you just registered in the Enable Banking Control Panel.
creds.applicationIdHint: The Application ID is also the downloaded .pem filename without the .pem extension. It is used as the Key ID too.
creds.prodAcknowledge: I confirm my Enable Banking application is in PRODUCTION mode (not SANDBOX).

keypair.modeGenerate: Advanced: use a server key pair
keypair.title: Use a Picsou server key pair
keypair.body: Use this option only if you manage the key registered with your application yourself. If Enable Banking downloaded a .pem file, import that file instead.
keypair.uploadInstruction: Your Enable Banking application must be registered with this exact public key. This is a public key, not a certificate. If the form asks for a certificate, keep its default browser key generation and import the downloaded .pem instead.
keypair.error: We couldn't generate a key pair. Please retry.
keypair.importTitle: Import your Enable Banking private key
keypair.importBody: Choose the <application-id>.pem file downloaded by Enable Banking when you registered this application, or paste its contents. Picsou stores the private key on your server.
keypair.importSuccess: Key imported. No public-key upload is needed. Derived public key:
keypair.importError: Could not read the key. Make sure it's a PKCS#8 .pem file from Enable Banking.

redirect.title: Register your Enable Banking application
redirect.body: In the Enable Banking Control Panel, open "Add a new application". Add this exact URL to the redirect URLs and fill in the checklist below.
redirect.environment: Environment: Production. Sandbox only provides fictitious test banks.
redirect.name: Name: Picsou, or a name you recognise.
redirect.description: Description, for example: "Personal use, aggregating my own accounts in a self-hosted Picsou instance".
redirect.email: Email for data protection matters: your own contact email.
redirect.policyUrls: Privacy URL and Terms URL are required. For a personal instance, review the repository links below as possible values. Use URLs that describe your own use.
redirect.keyMethod: Keep "Generate in the browser (using SubtleCrypto) and export private key". Register the application and keep the downloaded <application-id>.pem file for the import step.
redirect.activationBody: A new Production application is Inactive. Choose "Activate by linking accounts" and authorise your own bank accounts. Do not choose "Request activation", which is the commercial path.
redirect.restrictedMode: In restricted mode, only accounts linked to this application in the Enable Banking Control Panel are accessible. Before adding another bank in Picsou later, link its accounts there first.

test.title: Test your connection
test.body: We'll make a quick authenticated call to Enable Banking to make sure everything lines up.
test.activationNotice: Before testing, use "Activate by linking accounts" in the Enable Banking Control Panel and authorise your own accounts. Restricted mode only allows those linked accounts. "Request activation" is the commercial path.

hints.invalid_application_id: The Application ID doesn't match what Enable Banking has on file. Double-check it on the credentials step.
hints.invalid_key_id: Enable Banking rejected the request signature. Check that the Application ID and imported .pem belong to the same application, then check that you activated it with "Activate by linking accounts".
hints.public_key_not_uploaded: The application key does not match. Import the .pem downloaded for this Application ID. If you manage a server key pair, check that the application is registered with that exact public key.
hints.redirect_uri_mismatch: The redirect URI isn't whitelisted on Enable Banking's side. Re-check the redirect step.
hints.network: We couldn't reach Enable Banking. Check your network and try again.
hints.unknown: Something went wrong. Open the server logs if you need more detail.

test.successBody: This test checks the application configuration. Connect your bank accounts in Picsou after setup. Continue to the next integration.

bourso.title: Check the sidecar
bourso.body: Picsou ships with a bourso-auth container that syncs your BoursoBank accounts. We'll ping it to make sure it's reachable.
bourso.downHint: Make sure the bourso-auth container is running. Docker Compose starts it by default.

bourseDirect.title: Bourse Direct is ready.
bourseDirect.body: After setup, sign in with your Bourse Direct credentials and the 6-digit security code.
bourseDirect.tip: Picsou only stores an encrypted session. Your password and 2FA code are never stored. Imported accounts remain attached to their PEA or securities account.

tr.title: Trade Republic is ready to go.
tr.body: There's nothing to configure here — you'll sign in with your Trade Republic credentials when you add the account from Picsou.
tr.tip: Head to Accounts → Add account → Trade Republic once setup is done.

revolut.title: Revolut is ready to go.
revolut.body: Nothing to configure here — you'll connect Revolut with your phone number and passcode, then an approval from your mobile app, when you add the account.
revolut.tip: Head to Accounts → Add account → Revolut once setup is done.

finary.title: Finary is ready to go.
finary.body: Nothing to configure now — you'll sign in with your Finary account when you add it from Picsou. TOTP codes are handled at add-time if your account requires them.
finary.tip: Head to Accounts → Add account → Finary once setup is done.

crypto.title: Encrypt your exchange API keys
crypto.body: Your exchange API keys (Binance, Meria...) are encrypted at rest. Picsou can generate the encryption key for you — it stays on your disk and is never transmitted.
crypto.existed: Your encryption key is already configured — nothing to do.
crypto.error: We couldn't prepare the encryption key. Check the server logs.

complete.title: Picsou is ready.
complete.subtitle: Welcome, {{name}}.
complete.noIntegrations: You didn't enable any integrations yet — that's fine, you can do that anytime from Settings → Integrations.

fortuneo.title: Fortuneo is ready.
fortuneo.body: After setup, sign in with your Fortuneo credentials and the 6-digit security code.
fortuneo.tip: Picsou only stores an encrypted session. Your password and 2FA code are never stored. Imported accounts remain attached to their PEA, securities, or current account.

lbp.title: La Banque Postale is ready.
lbp.body: Connect your account after setup from Accounts → Add an account. You will enter your identifier, then your six digits on the bank's keypad.
lbp.tip: Picsou only stores an encrypted session and, if you ask, your identifier. The password and keypad positions are never stored.

savings.regulatedNet: Regulated product — interest is net of tax by law
savings.projectionDisclaimer: This is an estimate. The bank's annual credit is authoritative.

import.title: Import transactions from CSV
import.uploadHint: Drag & drop a CSV file here, or choose one
import.feesIncluded: Fees are already included in the amount

sidebarStylePrompt.title: Pick your sidebar style
sidebarStylePrompt.description: Two layouts to choose from — you can switch anytime.

form.autoValuationHint: Updates the property value monthly from French DVF open data. Turn off to freeze your own figure.
form.intro: Fill in the type, living area and address to enable automatic valuation.

details.title: Characteristics
details.coOwnedNote: You hold {{percent}} of this property. Totals count only your share.

valuation.title: Valuation
valuation.methodDisclaimer: These adjustments are rules of thumb: the DVF data records no floor, lift, garden or condition.
valuation.manualNotApplied: Manual mode is on: this estimate did not change the property value.

status.UNSUPPORTED_AREA: Automatic valuation is not available in this area.
status.UNSUPPORTED_AREA_hint: Alsace, Moselle and Mayotte use the livre foncier registry, so DVF holds no data there. Use the Patrim service on impots.gouv.fr and enter the value manually.
status.NOT_ESTIMABLE: This property type has no reliable price per m². Enter the value manually.
status.INCOMPLETE_DATA: Add the living area to enable the estimate.
status.GEOCODING_FAILED: The address could not be located. Check it and try again.
status.NO_COMPARABLE_DATA: No comparable transactions in this municipality.
status.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The data service is temporarily unavailable. The previous value is kept.

financing.title: Financing
financing.equityShare: {{pct}} of the property is genuinely yours

ownership.title: Ownership split
ownership.hint: Set each member's share. Everyone counts only their own part in their net worth.
ownership.overAllocated: The shares add up to more than 100%.
ownership.unassigned: {{percent}} is assigned to nobody: that part is held outside Picsou and counts towards no one's net worth.
ownership.saveError: Could not save the ownership split

add.title: Add a property
add.step1Hint: What kind of property are you adding?
add.step2Hint: Where is it, and how big is it?
add.name: Property name
add.addressHint: The address locates the municipality and is what makes automatic valuation possible.
add.feesHint: Fees make up the total cost: gain is measured against that, not against the purchase price alone.
add.notEstimable: This property type has no reliable price per m², so its value stays manually entered.

sheet.debtScopeNote: Covers every loan recorded, including accounts left out of this export

activation.title: Activate your account
activation.subtitle: Choose a password to complete your account setup.
activation.subtitleSso: Activate it with {{provider}}, or choose a password to complete your account setup.
activation.noticeBody: The administrator of this Picsou instance has technical access to all data stored here, including bank account details and API credentials. By activating your account, you acknowledge this.
activation.acknowledge: I understand and acknowledge that the admin has access to all data on this instance.

errors.acknowledgeRequired: You must acknowledge the data access warning.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.failed: Activation failed. The link may have expired.

reauth.ssoHint: {{provider}} will ask you to sign in again, then bring you back here.
reauth.expired: Your confirmation has expired. Please confirm your identity again.

ssoErrors.NOT_LINKED: This account is not linked to your sign-in provider. Sign in with your password, then link it from Settings.
ssoErrors.NOT_IN_ADMIN_GROUP: Your account is not in the group required to administer this instance.
ssoErrors.IDENTITY_IN_USE: This identity is already linked to another account.
ssoErrors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Please confirm your identity again to continue.
ssoErrors.REAUTH_TOO_OLD: Your last confirmation is too old. Please confirm your identity again.
ssoErrors.REAUTH_WRONG_ACCOUNT: You confirmed a different account than the one you are signed in with. Please use the same account.
ssoErrors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: This account is inactive. Contact your administrator.
ssoErrors.ADMIN_RECOVERY_ACTIVE: An administrator recovery is in progress for this account. Finish it before signing in with SSO.
ssoErrors.ACTIVATION_INVALID: Single sign-on isn't available with this link. If it's a password reset link, set a new password with the form instead. Otherwise the link is invalid, has expired or was already used: ask your administrator for a new one.
ssoErrors.SETUP_ALREADY_CLAIMED: The initial setup has already been claimed by another administrator.
ssoErrors.IDP_UNAVAILABLE: The sign-in provider is unreachable. Please try again in a few minutes.
ssoErrors.IDP_ERROR: The sign-in provider returned an error. Please try again.
ssoErrors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your sign-in attempt expired. Please start again.
ssoErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
ssoErrors.SSO_ADMIN_REQUIRED: First-time setup requires an administrator from your sign-in provider. Use SSO to create the administrator account.
ssoErrors.IDENTITY_NOT_USED_YET: You have not signed in with SSO yet. Sign in once with it before turning off password sign-in.
ssoErrors.LAST_SIGN_IN_METHOD: This is your last sign-in method. Add another one before removing it.
ssoErrors.PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET: A password is already set for this account.
ssoErrors.REAUTH_FAILED: Re-authentication failed. Check your credentials and try again.
ssoErrors.SSO_REVALIDATE: Your session needs to be re-validated with your sign-in provider.
ssoErrors.SSO_DISABLED: Single sign-on is not enabled on this instance.
ssoErrors.SELF_UNLINK_FORBIDDEN: To unlink your own SSO identities, use Sign-in methods in Settings.
ssoErrors.generic: Single sign-on failed. Please try again.
